concerns.text: The plan states a **Performance Goal** of ≤ 6 h wall‑clock for the full sweep (5 seeds × 3 α × 5 ε × DP + non‑DP runs). Even with the optimistic 30 s per round estimate and a maximum of 50 rounds, this amounts to roughly 150 runs × 50 rounds × 30 s ≈ 62 hours of compute, far exceeding the 6 h budget of a GitHub Actions free‑tier runner. The early‑stop logic caps rounds only after the run has started, so the orchestrator will still launch a large number of configurations before hitting the budget limit, leading to many runs being prematurely terminated and excluded from analysis. This makes the study infeasible under the stated resource constraints.
